headline: Jagran Prakashan highlights SEBI's compliance timeline for physical share dematerialization
summary: Jagran Prakashan has informed shareholders about the SEBI-mandated window to dematerialize legacy physical shares. This regulatory compliance effort impacts retail investors holding physical certificates of the company. Dematerialization is required to facilitate easier trading and enhanced transparency in the securities market. Indian retail investors holding legacy paper shares must complete the process to avoid operational restrictions on their holdings.
whats_next: SEBI physical share demat compliance deadline
why_it_matters: Physical share holders must dematerialize to retain trading access

headline: SEBI opens special window for physical share demat of Jagran Prakashan
hook: Dematerialization window opens for physical holders
summary: SEBI has introduced a special window facilitating the dematerialization of physical shares for listed companies, including Jagran Prakashan. This regulatory mechanism allows shareholders holding legacy physical certificates to convert them into electronic form. Converting physical shares to demat is mandatory for seamless trading on major stock exchanges like the NSE and BSE. Indian retail investors holding legacy paper certificates benefit by gaining liquidity and easier portfolio management.
why_it_matters: Physical shareholders can convert certificates for easier exchange trading.

headline: Jagran Prakashan submits SEBI Regulation 74(5) compliance certificate for Q2 FY2026
summary: Jagran Prakashan has submitted its SEBI Regulation 74(5) compliance certificate for the second quarter of financial year 2026. This regulatory filing confirms the proper dematerialisation and rematerialisation of securities during the period. The submission is a mandatory procedural requirement for listed companies under securities regulations. For an Indian retail investor, this routine compliance filing has no direct bearing on the company's financial performance or stock price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on stock value.

headline: Jagran Prakashan submits SEBI depository compliance certificate
hook: Routine quarterly compliance filing from Jagran
summary: Jagran Prakashan has submitted its compliance certificate under SEBI regulations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The filing was sent to the stock exchange as a routine regulatory requirement. Retail investors tracking the media company see standard procedural disclosure.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no direct impact on share price
